about: Line-oriented UTF-8 records and brace-delimited sections. Quoted tokens retain spaces. Paths use zero-based occurrence indices, for example SAMPLER[0]/HQ[0]/mastervol[0]. The VST3 processor wraps the same text in VstW/FBCh with plugin ID SD3a and preserves opaque bytes following the NUL-terminated text. Section header arguments use a /$args suffix. Edits preserve each record value count and numeric or text type.

SAMPLER[0]/HQ[0]/mastervol[0].about: Sampler master volume. Kumi supports attenuation only: 0..1 is its supported write interval, not a claim about the full UI range. Native restore/readback confirmed both endpoints and 0.25/0.5 intermediate values.
